name: Naran-Kaghan
description: A cool summer valley along the Kunhar River, with Lake Saiful Muluk and the road over Babusar Top.
lead: Lakes, glaciers and the road over Babusar Top, a cool escape from the summer heat

image.alt: Lake Saiful Muluk lying still, mirroring green slopes and the snowy peaks above it

overview.headline: A cool green valley on the road to Babusar
paragraphs: The Kaghan Valley follows the Kunhar River north from Balakot, climbing through pine forest to Naran, the valley’s main town and the base for its lakes.

Above it lie Lake Saiful Muluk under Malika Parbat, the long blue water of Lulusar, and the road over Babusar Top into Gilgit-Baltistan. It is a summer valley: the road above Naran opens only once the snow clears.

seasons.text: The road reaches Naran in May, but the lakes are still frozen. Days 10–18°C.
The season proper: Babusar Top opens in June and the lakes thaw. Days 18–25°C, cool nights.
Clear, quiet days in September and early October. Most hotels close by November.
Heavy snow closes the valley above Kaghan, and Naran shuts until spring.

places.name: Siri Paye
places.text: High meadows above Shogran, facing Makra Peak, reached by jeep.

image.alt: Bright green meadows and pines at Siri Paye, with a snowy peak mirrored in a small pool

places.name: Kunhar River
places.text: The fast, green river the valley follows, with riverside walks below Naran.

image.alt: The broad Kunhar River flows past gravel bars between steep pine-covered slopes toward a distant peak.

places.name: Lake Saiful Muluk
places.text: The valley’s famous lake under Malika Parbat, a short jeep ride above Naran.

image.alt: Lake Saiful Muluk lying still under snow-streaked mountains, with a stony path along its shore

places.name: Lulusar Lake
places.text: A long, blue lake at the head of the valley, the source of the Kunhar.

image.alt: Green Lulusar Lake between steep slopes with snow patches, under a blue sky

places.name: Babusar Top
places.text: The pass at 4,173 m between Kaghan and Gilgit-Baltistan, open in summer.

image.alt: The Babusar road snakes down a green valley in tight hairpins from the pass, between grassy slopes and distant ridges.

gettingThere.byRoad: The motorway and the Hazara Expressway to Mansehra, then up the Kaghan Valley along the Kunhar.
gettingThere.byAir: There’s no airport in the valley. We go by road.

notes.title: The season is short
notes.text: The road above Naran opens around June and closes with the first snow. Outside summer, most hotels are shut.

notes.title: Jeeps to the lakes
notes.text: Saiful Muluk is a short jeep ride above Naran on a rough track; the jeep is included in our trips.

notes.title: Mobile signal
notes.text: Signal is good in Naran and gone at the lakes and on Babusar Top.
